svg.text: EU nationals; spouse of a Greek WITH a child; custody of a Greek child born in Greece; stateless persons
Everybody else holding a title on the closed list of art. 5(1)(ε) — the investor permit is item αθ
Any other valid residence title, temporary ones excepted — art. 5(3)
All three are «συνεχή» — continuous. The Code gives no window inside which broken periods may be added together.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 8 September 2026
